# ponte_mcp_tool_risk_tier (Resource)

The declared risk tier of one tool on a registered MCP server. Policies read the declared tier. The tool must be pinned first (sync the server). Destroy removes the resource from state and leaves the declaration in Ponte.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The server must have been synced, so the tool is pinned.
resource "ponte_mcp_tool_risk_tier" "crm_delete_account" {
  server_id = ponte_mcp_server.crm.id
  tool      = "delete_account"
  risk_tier = "destructive"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `risk_tier` (String) read, write, external_send, destructive or code_exec.
- `server_id` (String) ponte_mcp_server id.
- `tool` (String) The tool's name as the server lists it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) server_id/tool

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ponte_mcp_tool_risk_tier.crm_delete_account res_0123456789ab/delete_account
```
